explication: BrimDeck is a Windows 11 desktop Dynamic Island that brings AI-tool usage, music, system readings, device batteries, and clipboard/file transfer into an expandable top-of-screen panel. The user workflow is to open the panel, inspect or control a feature, and configure its presentation in settings. The map includes the documented feature areas and the core service/native layers; relationships not demonstrated by the excerpts or README are omitted.
